key_insight: A dependency-aware greedy scheduler can exploit fine-grained parallelism in multi-core quantum circuits to cut makespan beyond simple layer-by-layer execution.
engineering_relevance: This work provides a practical scheduling strategy for improving core utilization and reducing communication-induced idle time in near-term multi-core quantum hardware.
method: Baseline: execute all gates in each circuit layer in parallel, then move sequentially to the next layer.
Proposed greedy scheduler: launch each gate as soon as its dependencies and required resources are available.
Target both computation and communication overlap to better use multiple quantum cores.
evidence_signal: On real benchmarks, the greedy approach achieved an average 40% reduction in makespan and improved core utilization.
watch_item: Results depend on accurate dependency tracking and resource/communication modeling, so performance may vary with hardware constraints and inter-core latency.
paper_title: Dependency-Aware Circuit Scheduling for Multi-Core Quantum Systems to Minimize Makespan
